title: First sorting contraction identity
statement: Let X be a scheme, I a linearly ordered type, U : I -> Opens(X) any family, F an abelian-group presheaf, and S a SiteCechComplex for U over the terminal open [def-pc-scheme, def-sc-zariski-site, def-weil-pbc-site-cech-complex]. Let H and kappa be the concrete finite-sum operators [def-pc-alternating-cech-sorting-operators]. For every p >= 0, the p-th component of Homotopy.nullHomotopicMap' H equals identity minus kappa_p. This is precisely dH+Hd=id-kappa, with the incoming differential zero in degree zero.

proof.text: Define the signed partial sorting stage B_a by the finite sum over stable sigma and permutations tau that agree with sigma before a and increase afterwards. At a=0 the partial filter is equivalent to tau=identity: a strictly increasing permutation of Fin(p+1) is identity (Equiv.Perm.monotone_iff). Tuple.eq_sort_iff identifies the stable filter with sigma=Tuple.sort(t), so its sum has multiplicity one. The identity index map is identity (arrows of scheme opens are subsingleton), and its presheaf restriction is identity. Hence B_0(s)=s. At a=p+1 the partial filter is tau=sigma; the tail condition is vacuous, and the finite sum is exactly the stable sorting map. These endpoint calculations are proved in Lean.

In degree zero, unpack the null homotopic map using Homotopy.nullHomotopicMap'_f_of_not_rel_right. The incoming differential is absent. The first homotopy evaluates on the duplicated singleton tuple. Its differential has two terms, which are opposite restrictions of the same section: the two face tuples are definitionally identical after replacing the junction map by the constant map to Fin 1, and both restriction arrows are equal since opens form a preorder. Stable sorting in degree zero is identity. This case is proved directly in Lean.

In positive degree p+1, unpack Homotopy.nullHomotopicMap'_f into the two ordinary differential composites. Evaluate on a cochain and tuple. Apply the uncancelled-junction boundary lemma to identify their sum with sum over a in Fin(p+2) of B_a(s)(t)-B_(a+1)(s)(t). This is the sole remaining dependency with sorry.

Use Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range and Finset.sum_range_sub' to telescope the differences of consecutive partial stages: sum over a in Fin n of f(a)-f(a+1) is f(0)-f(n). Apply this to the partial stages at the tuple. Rewrite the proved endpoints B_0=id and B_(p+2)=stable sorting in degree p+1. Equality of homomorphisms follows by AddCommGrpCat.ext and function extensionality.

lean.statement: theorem cechFirstSortingIdentity (X : Scheme.{u}) {I : Type v} [LinearOrder I] (U : I → X.Opens) (F : X.Opensᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{w}) (S : SiteCechComplex U (fun i ↦ homOfLE (le_top : U i ≤ ⊤))) (p : ℕ) : (Homotopy.nullHomotopicMap' (cechFirstSortingFamily X U F S)).f p = 𝟙 (S.cochains F p) - cechStableSortingMap X U F S p
